title: MiniZoo: An Evolving Dataset of Mini Apps for the Research Community
abstract: arXiv:2611.13125v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mini apps run within host applications (apps) such as WeChat, Alipay, Baidu, and Telegram, providing services without requiring users to install separate native apps. Their growing ecosystem has attracted research on software quality, security, and privacy, creating a need for reusable datasets. However, building and maintaining such datasets is challenging, requiring platform-specific collection infrastructure and mechanisms to handle incomplete packages, changing availability, and heterogeneous metadata. A shared, continuously maintained collection is still lacking, therefore motivating the development of a common research resource, whose value has been demonstrated by the experience of AndroZoo in the Android ecosystem. In this paper, we present MiniZoo, an evolving corpus of mini apps and associated metadata. The initial release comprises 16,273 mini-app packages, with multiple versions of the same mini apps. translated_title: MiniZoo：一个面向研究社区的不断演化的小程序数据集
translated_abstract: 小程序运行在微信、支付宝、百度和 Telegram 等宿主应用之中，无需用户安装单独的原生应用即可提供服务。其不断增长的生态系统吸引了关于软件质量、安全与隐私方面的研究，从而产生了对可复用数据集的需求。然而，构建和维护此类数据集极具挑战性，需要针对特定平台的采集基础设施，以及应对不完整软件包、可用性变化和异构元数据的机制。目前仍缺乏一个共享的、持续维护的小程序集合，这促使人们开发一种共同的研究资源，而 AndroZoo 在 Android 生态系统中的经验已经证明了这种资源的价值。本文提出了 MiniZoo，一个小程序及其相关元数据的不断演化的语料库。其初始版本包含 16,273 个小程序软件包，其中同一小程序具有多个版本。该数据集的管理……
tldr: 本文提出 MiniZoo——一个面向研究社区持续维护、不断演化的小程序数据集，初始版本包含16,273个软件包，为软件质量、安全与隐私等领域的研究提供了共享资源。
en_tdlr: This paper presents MiniZoo, an evolving and continuously maintained dataset of mini apps with metadata—initially comprising 16,273 packages—to serve as a shared research resource for studies on software quality, security, and privacy.
